name: Orion Minerals Limited
source: Orion Minerals Limited Annual Report 2026 (audited, Forvis Mazars unmodified opinion with a material uncertainty relating to going concern), consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, year ended 30 June 2026; ASX announcement copy; figures in AUD (statement printed in A$ thousands). Operating Expenses is employee expenses 2,781 plus exploration and evaluation costs expensed 2,649 plus other operational expenses 5,795 (A$11,225k). Operating Profit (EBIT) -10,903 is the statement's own 'Results from operating activities' line, after Other Income 322. Profit Before Tax -12,687 is after non-operating expenses 1,330 and net finance expenses 454, which is the Net Finance Costs row (positive means an expense, the convention this file already uses for FY2025 1,723). Income tax is nil. Net Profit is the group loss for the year A$12,687k. EPS is the basic and headline loss per share of A$0.12.
